definitions.explanation: Electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths longer than visible light. Used in remote controls, heaters, sensors, and medical equipment.

examples.japanese: リモコンは{赤外線|せきがいせん}で{信号|しんごう}を{送|おく}る。
examples.english: The remote control sends signals using infrared.

examples.japanese: {赤外線|せきがいせん}センサーが{人|ひと}の{動|うご}きを{感知|かんち}する。
examples.english: The infrared sensor detects people's movement.

examples.japanese: {赤外線|せきがいせん}ヒーターは{体|からだ}の{芯|しん}から{温|あたた}まるので{冬|ふゆ}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Infrared heaters warm you from the core, so they are popular in winter.

notes:
USAGE:
{赤外線|せきがいせん} literally means "beyond-red rays" — light beyond the red end of the visible spectrum. The word appears in everyday contexts (heaters, remote controls, sensors) as well as scientific ones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {赤外線|せきがいせん}センサー (infrared sensor)
- {赤外線|せきがいせん}ヒーター (infrared heater)
- {赤外線|せきがいせん}カメラ (infrared camera)
- {赤外線|せきがいせん}{通信|つうしん} (infrared communication)
- {近赤外線|きんせきがいせん} (near-infrared)

RELATED WORDS:
- {紫外線|しがいせん}: ultraviolet (beyond violet)
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}: radiation
- {可視光線|かしこうせん}: visible light
